summary.text: Erika Geiss is a Democratic member of the Michigan Senate for the 1st District, which includes all of Ecorse, Lincoln Park, Melvindale and River Rouge and parts of Allen Park, Detroit and Taylor.
The Michigan Senate Democrats biography describes Geiss as Assistant President Pro Tempore, serving a second Senate term after two terms in the Michigan House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Geiss earned a bachelor's degree in developmental psychology from Brandeis University and a master's degree in art and architectural history from Tufts University, according to the Michigan Senate Democrats biography.
The biography calls her the granddaughter of Panamanian immigrants and says she has spent most of her adult life in Michigan.
Her biography says she served two terms in the Michigan House and then, in her first Senate term, as Democratic Caucus Chair.

It lists her legislative work as improving standards of care for pregnant and nursing prisoners at the state's only women's prison, improving communication with the Federal Railroad Administration to reduce blocked rail crossings in her community, and developing implicit bias training standards for health care professionals.
Geiss and her husband, Doug, live in Taylor and have two children, according to the biography.
